entries.partTitle: Global E-Commerce Data Tier: Decoupled Multi-Model Storage & Request Routing

left.title: Monolithic Database
items: Forces diverse access patterns into single engine.
High lock contention on catalog and orders.
Exorbitant vertical scaling costs under load.

items: Valkey accelerates hot catalog reads in memory.
DynamoDB handles high throughput checkouts.
Aurora maintains strict financial ledger tables.

entries.partTitle: Hot Read Acceleration: Distributed Valkey Caching & Mutex Stampede Protection

left.title: Unprotected Caching
items: Expired hot keys trigger simultaneous database reads.
Connection pools collapse under sudden spikes.
High latency degrades flash sale user experience.

right.title: Valkey Stampede Guard
items: Serves five hundred reads from memory in one millisecond.
Distributed mutex lock restricts database fetches to one.
Allkeys-lru eviction preserves hot working set.

entries.partTitle: Core Ordering: DynamoDB Single-Table Transactions & Item Collections

left.title: Multi-Table Relational
items: Multi-table checkout transactions incur row locks.
High contention on inventory rows causes deadlocks.
Variable latency exceeds fifty milliseconds.

right.title: Single-Table DynamoDB
items: TransactWriteItems commits orders and stock atomically.
Condition checks eliminate inventory overselling.
Single-digit millisecond latency at any concurrency.

entries.partTitle: Financial Settlement: Aurora Global Database & Amazon RDS Proxy Pooling

left.title: Unmanaged PostgreSQL
items: Surging serverless functions exhaust connections.
Failover requires minutes of DNS propagation.
High cross-region replication lag risks data loss.

right.title: Aurora Global + Proxy
items: RDS Proxy multiplexes hundreds of client sessions.
Storage level replication achieves zero recovery point.
Strict ACID ledger guarantees mathematical balancing.

entries.partTitle: Capstone Verification: End-to-End Sub-10ms Pipeline & Confirmation Token

left.title: Fragmented Architecture
items: Sequential execution inflates latency over sixty ms.
Single point of failure during regional outages.
Lacks automated cross-tier verification token.

right.title: Synthesized Tier
items: Parallel pipeline completes checkout in eight milliseconds.
Multi-AZ failover and cross-region durability.
Emits cryptographic confirmation token upon test.
